title: Erlang/OTP 26+ (rebar3 + Cowboy)
summary: Erlang/OTP 26+, rebar3, supervision trees, Dialyzer -spec types
rules: OTP Supervision: All long-running processes must be placed under an OTP supervisor ('let it crash').
GenServer callbacks separation: Strictly separate public API (call/cast) from server callbacks.
Pattern matching in function heads and guards over nested case/if statements.
Declare -spec type specifications for all exported functions to ensure clean Dialyzer runs.
